Name: Bimbo Valley
Author: OverTheBridge
Description:
[size=5]Welcome to Bimbo Valley![/size]

This is a NSFW mod that allows you to transform the women of the valley into hot bimbos. As your relationship with each valley girl grows, they will progressively enter new stages of transformation. These changes tend to occur every 1 - 3 hearts. Each stage has a new set of portraits, new sprites, and new dialogue. These also include Winter and Beach portraits and sprites!

This mod is now also compatible with Xtardew Valley! The optional Xtardew expansion contains nudity portaits & characters, new dialogue, and new events, all using the bimbofied versions of each of the girls.

The current Stardew women that can be bimbofied include:
[list]
[*]Abigail[/*]
[*]Emily[/*]
[*]Haley[/*]
[*]Leah[/*]
[*]Maru[/*]
[*]Penny[/*]
[*]Sandy[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Caroline[/*]
[*]Jodi[/*]
[*]Robin[/*]
[*]Marnie[/*]
[/list]
Additionally, Bimbo Valley is now compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded! In update 1.4, you can now bimbofy the SVE bachelorettes:
[list]
[*]Claire[/*]
[*]Olivia[/*]
[*]Scarlett[/*]
[*]Sophia[/*]
[/list]
You can set stage limits to individual valley girls, as well as disable bimbofication entirely for certain girls! In order to access that menu, you'll need the generic mod menu mod.

Bimbo Valley is made up of edits of a lot of different mod creators' art, as well as my own. Please check out the permissions section if you'd like to seek out the works used in this mod and support other modders!

This mod will not play nice with other portrait or sprite altering mods, so please ensure other portrait mods are disabled. It may also conflict with any mod that adds or alters dialogue.

[b]How to Install Base Mod:[/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Manually install the zipped folder titled "[CP] Bimbo Valley".[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Extract the zipped folder into your "Mods" folder in the Stardew Valley game directory. The default path is usually "c:\Program Files\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley"[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]That's it! When you start the game the mod should boot up as well.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=2][b]How to Install Xtardew Valley Expansion:[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install the Xtardew Valley mod and all required additional mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install the Optional "Xtardew Valley" file in the Bimbo Valley mod page.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Unzip that file and drop the three folders inside into the Xtardew Valley mod directory[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Replace all contents[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]You should now have the Bimbo Valley version of Xtardew Valley![/size][/*]
[/list]
